Stack: React 18 + Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind + shadcn/ui + Framer Motion. Never use `any` type.

## Task: Sprint 6C — SEO Landing Pages

Create 3 SEO-optimized landing pages targeting high-intent keywords for organic traffic. Each page is public (no auth required) and follows the existing landing page design patterns.

### Read these files first:
- `src/pages/Landing.tsx` — current landing page structure
- `src/components/landing/Hero.tsx` — hero section pattern
- `src/components/landing/HowItWorks.tsx` — how it works section pattern
- `src/components/landing/FAQ.tsx` — FAQ section pattern
- `src/components/landing/FinalCTA.tsx` — CTA section pattern
- `src/components/landing/LandingNavbar.tsx` — navbar component (reuse)
- `src/components/landing/LandingFooter.tsx` — footer component (reuse)
- `src/App.tsx` — current routes
- `src/components/shared/UrlInput.tsx` — URL input for CTA sections

### 1. SEO Page Template Component

**Create `src/components/seo/SeoPageLayout.tsx`:**
A reusable layout wrapper for SEO pages:
- Props: `children: React.ReactNode; title: string; description: string`
- Renders: LandingNavbar + children + LandingFooter
- Sets document title via useEffect: `document.title = title + " | ConvertScan"`
- Sets meta description via useEffect (create/update meta tag)

### 2. Three SEO Pages

**Create `src/pages/seo/CroAuditTool.tsx`:**
Target keyword: "CRO audit tool"
- Hero: "Free CRO Audit Tool — Score Your Website in 60 Seconds"
- Subtitle: "Paste any URL and get AI-powered conversion rate optimization analysis with specific, actionable fix recommendations"
- URL input CTA (reuse UrlInput component, links to /scan)
- "What is a CRO Audit?" section: 3-paragraph explainer
- "What We Check" section: 7 pillar cards (reuse CRO_PILLARS data from constants)
- "How Our CRO Tool Works" section: 3 steps (paste URL → AI analyzes → get fixes)
- Comparison section: "ConvertScan vs Manual CRO Audits" — simple 2-column comparison
- FAQ section: 5 CRO-audit-specific questions
- Final CTA: "Start Your Free CRO Audit"

**Create `src/pages/seo/LandingPageAnalyzer.tsx`:**
Target keyword: "landing page analyzer"
- Hero: "Landing Page Analyzer — Find What's Killing Your Conversions"
- Subtitle: "AI-powered analysis of your landing page's headlines, CTAs, trust signals, mobile UX, and page speed"
- URL input CTA
- "Why Landing Pages Fail" section: 5 common problems with stats
- "What We Analyze" section: feature cards (CTA placement, trust signals, mobile UX, copy strength, page speed)
- Social proof: "Trusted by 500+ marketing teams" (placeholder)
- Case study section: before/after example (static content showing score improvement)
- FAQ: 5 landing-page-specific questions
- Final CTA

**Create `src/pages/seo/ConversionRateOptimization.tsx`:**
Target keyword: "conversion rate optimization tool"
- Hero: "Conversion Rate Optimization Tool — AI-Powered CRO for Every Page"
- Subtitle: "Stop guessing. Get data-driven conversion recommendations backed by AI analysis of 80+ CRO factors"
- URL input CTA
- "The CRO Problem" section: most businesses lose money due to poor conversion, stats
- "Our 7-Pillar Framework" section: detailed breakdown of each pillar with what we check
- Pricing teaser: 3 tiers mentioned briefly with "See all plans" link to /pricing
- "Who Uses ConvertScan" section: 3 personas (solo marketer, startup, agency)
- FAQ: 5 CRO-tool-specific questions
- Final CTA

### 3. Design Guidelines

Each page should:
- Use the same dark hero section pattern as Landing.tsx (bg-slate-950 gradient)
- Use framer-motion for scroll-reveal animations (fadeInUp with stagger)
- Have unique content (not copy-pasted between pages)
- Include an H1 with the target keyword
- Use H2 for section headers
- Include the URL input CTA at least twice (hero + bottom)
- Be fully responsive (mobile-first)
- Use existing component patterns: Card, Badge, Button from shadcn/ui
- Import LandingNavbar and LandingFooter for consistent navigation

### 4. Routes

**Modify `src/App.tsx`:**
- Add 3 PUBLIC routes (no ProtectedRoute):
  - `/cro-audit-tool` → CroAuditTool
  - `/landing-page-analyzer` → LandingPageAnalyzer
  - `/conversion-rate-optimization` → ConversionRateOptimization
- Lazy load all 3 pages

### Requirements:
- No `any` types
- Each page has unique, substantial content (500+ words each for SEO value)
- Use semantic HTML (h1, h2, h3, section, article)
- All URL inputs link to /scan with query param
- Follow existing landing page visual style exactly
- Framer Motion animations for section entrances
- No placeholder/lorem ipsum — write real, compelling copy about CRO and ConvertScan
